title: Dissociation Barriers for Odd-Numbered Acyclic Nitrogen Molecules N9 and N11
authors: Thompson M.D., Bledson T.M., Strout D.L.
journal_year: J. Phys. Chem. A (2002), PAGE EST 2.9
notes_general: Paper studies dissociation TRANSITION STATES (Figures 2-4, 6-9) which are not minima -- only the two parent minimum-energy molecules (Figure 1: N9, Figure 5: N11, both C2v zigzag chains, doublet) are extracted here. Both figures show a clean, unbranched, left-to-right zigzag chain with HF/CC-PVDZ bond lengths/angles (MP2/CC-PVDZ in parentheses) -- no atom-index labels needed since chain order is visually unambiguous. Values transcribed with moderate-to-good confidence (clean simple figures) but not verified against a printed numeric table -- suggest double-checking against the image before using for exact (Niveau 1) reconstruction; geom.py's chain2d() function is a direct fit for this data shape.
